shortDescription: Module to manage VM pools in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster, where VM pool should be created.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment of the Virtual Machine pool.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the vmpool to manage.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the VM pool to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: prestarted
options.description: Number of pre-started VMs defines the number of VMs in run state, that are waiting to be attached to Users. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the VM pool be present/absent. Note that when C(state) is I(absent) all VMs in VM pool are stopped and removed.

options.name: template
options.description: Name of the template, which will be used to create VM pool.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the VM pool. Either manual or automatic. C(manual) - The administrator is responsible for explicitly returning the virtual machine to the pool. The virtual machine reverts to the original base image after the administrator returns it to the pool. C(Automatic) - When the virtual machine is shut down, it automatically reverts to its base image and is returned to the virtual machine pool. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: vm
options.description: For creating vm pool without editing template. Note: You can use C(vm) only for creating vm pool.

options.name: vm_count
options.description: Number of VMs in the pool. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: vm_per_user
options.description: Maximum number of VMs a single user can attach to from this pool. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
